nature_language: 当前位置上海。我两个人想去北京玩3天，预算8000人民币，住一间大床房，酒店最好有管家服务，想去故宫博物院看一下，请给我一个旅行规划。
nature_language_en: Current location: Shanghai. Two of us want to visit Beijing for 3 days with a budget of 8,000 RMB. We would like to stay in a hotel with a king-size bed, preferably with butler service. We want to visit the Forbidden City. Please provide a travel plan.
